P.A.W.S - Personal Automated Wagging Sys.name: P.A.W.S.: Personal Automated Wagging System
P.A.W.S - Personal Automated Wagging Sys.summary: The world's first dog simulation puts players in the cockpit of the family dog. Roam the backyard from a first-person perspective, see a comical explanation of how dogs work on the inside, or take to the city on a funny dog rescue mission.
